title: An Act to Prevent Conflicts of Interest When Voting on Municipal Employee Compensation

summary.text: This bill prohibits a municipal voter, including a voter in a city, town or plantation, from voting on an article or referendum question if the voter has a direct pecuniary interest in the outcome of the article or referendum question. It also directs the Secretary of State to produce and publicly disseminate guidance for municipal clerks on how to implement this prohibition.
